The Financial Crime (FC) Function is a Second line of defence (LOD) function that includes 'Risk Stewards' who are independent of the commercial risk-taking activities undertaken by the Group's businesses (also referred to as 'the First LOD' or 'FLOD'). The FC Function also operates a set of critical controls on behalf of the FLOD by harnessing intelligence, analytics, technology, detection and investigation. The Risk Stewards are responsible for reviewing and challenging all the activities of the FLOD to ensure that, as 'Risk Owners', they effectively manage the FC risk inherent in, or arising from, the conduct of their activities and for which they are responsible. FC risk is a non-financial risk that includes fraud, money laundering, bribery and corruption, sanctions violations, terrorist financing, proliferation financing, export control violations and tax evasion. The FC Function operates in accordance with HSBC Group's Risk Management Framework (RMF). The VP, CIB IWPB FC will primarily be responsible for providing financial crime risk stewardship across customers, products and geographies related to Digital Assets and Currencies within CIB business. Coordonner la mise en place de circuits opérationnels et de reporting Optimiser les outils de suivi de l'activité et améliorer les processus de l'équipe par l'utilisation de l'IA Participer à des groupes de travail sur des projets réglementaires, techniques ou commerciaux Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 / Bac +5 dans le cadre d'un Master avec une spécialisation financière (M1/M2 - Grande Ecole de Commerce, Université), et recherchez une alternance d'une durée de deux ans. Doté d'une aisance relationnelle et rédactionnelle, vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement international et êtes à l'aise en matière de coordination de projets. Vous avez le sens du travail en équipe et savez mener vos projets d'une façon rigoureuse et autonome, dans des délais stricts. Vous êtes organisé et avez le sens des priorités. Une excellente maîtrise de l'anglais et des outils bureautiques (Excel, VBA) est indispensable. La pratique de l'Italien serait un atout.

Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, Hang Seng offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. Private Banking Department - Private Banking and Trust Services Hang Seng's Private Banking provides services for people who have successfully built their asset base and now want to place their wealth in the hands of experts who know how to nurture it. Our banking services and products are bespoke, ranging from tailored investment advice and capital solutions to holistic health and personal protection and trustee services. Our team offers professional wealth management advice at both a local level and on a global scale. Should you join our Private Banking business, you will focus on building close relationship with our high-net-worth customers, providing professional advice and premium service to them and contribute to the profitability of the Bank. We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as Business Risk Management Manager , reporting to Head of Business Risk Management. Principal responsibilities RBW Support the Head of Business Risk Management to maintain and enhance a robust business risk and control framework to enable effective oversight, control and monitoring for Private Banking and Trustee, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Group/Bank policies. Maintain and continuously improve the business risk and control framework for Private Banking and Trustee activities. Establish and maintain effective risk management controls; lead periodic reviews of control procedures and monitoring programmes to ensure ongoing effectiveness. Design and implement policies, procedures and controls to meet Group and regulatory requirements, balancing customer experience and operational effect
